description: This file defines a class 'BIFF8' which provides a mapping from BIFF8 color indices to RGB color codes used in Excel BIFF8 format files. It includes a private color map array and a method to lookup colors by index.

classes.name: BIFF8
classes.description: Provides a mapping of BIFF8 color indices to RGB hexadecimal color codes, including a method for retrieving the color for a given index.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns an array with the RGB color corresponding to the BIFF8 color index, defaulting to black if the index is not found.
